name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B
notes: Same Qwen2 dense architecture as the Qwen2.5-7B parent (hidden 3584, 28 layers, 28 query heads / 4 KV heads); safetensors total 7615616512. head_dim derived as 3584 / 28 = 128 (absent from config.json). gqa_ratio = 28 / 4 = 7. No rope_scaling; 131072 declared natively. Serving note: this is the most-downloaded single-GPU reasoning distill and the standard 4-bit-quantisation target; the architecture is unchanged from the base model, so quantisation kernels, KV-cache sizing and batching all transfer directly.KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 28 layers x 4 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 57344 B/token = 56.0 KiB/token. At 128k context that is 7.00 GiB of KV for one sequence at bf16.
